description:
How would you like to work in IT, toying with cutting edge technologies and enjoying your life? At Orange Services this is possible!

As one of the largest IT Hub within Orange Group, we are working internationally for both Orange corporate functions and country operations. Through a unique combination of know-how and expertise, our teams provide a broad range of IT & Business Solutions.

Come closer to #LifeAtOrange


What we are looking for

A talented and passionate ServiceNow HRSD Developer to join our ServiceNow Solution team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in ServiceNow Human Resources Service Delivery (HRSD) and a deep understanding of HR processes. This role offers an exciting opportunity to stay up-to-date with the latest ServiceNow HRSD features and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


What you’ll be doing

  • Create, complete, and document User Stories related to HRSD processes
  • Analyze, design, and estimate User Stories
  • Develop, test, and deploy User Stories within the ServiceNow environment, integrating ServiceNow with other HR systems
  • Configure HR Services, Lifecycle Events, and Journeys, building forms, workflows, and portals for HRSD
  • Maintain and update ServiceNow HRSD environments
  • Write technical support documentation and specialized guides
  • Conduct post-implementation testing to ensure quality
  • Participate in agile ceremonies (Sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives)
  • Provide technical assistance and resolve incidents related to ServiceNow HRSD
  • Stay current with updates and new features of ServiceNow HRSD to ensure continuous improvement of the implemented solution


What you need to know/have

  • Over 5 years of experience in ServiceNow HRSD development
  • Previous experience in solution analysis, design, and technical estimation
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript for client and server-side development
  • Understanding of relational database concepts
  • Knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs for integration and advanced experience with Flow Designer
  • Expertise in scripting: client scripts, UI Policies, Business Rules, Script Includes
  • Familiarity with HRSD/ServiceNow best practices (preferably certified in ServiceNow CIS-HRSD) and understanding of HR processes
  • Experience in automating and industrializing deployment processes
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills, strong analytical abilities, and a solution-oriented mindset
  • Clarity, simplicity, and structure in communication
  • Active listening skills to understand business needs
  • Fluency in English is a must and at least B1 level in French will be a strong advantage
  • Bachelor’s Degree in a related discipline.


What’s in it for you

  • Performance Bonuses– based on your results & the company’s
  • Electronic Meal Tickets
  • Medical & Life insurance for you - facilities for your family, too
  • Professional GSM subscription
  • Personal GSM subscription, also [because we believe in communication!]
  • Special grants on Smartphones & devices; discounts for Orange products & services
  • Development Platforms - Orange Learning, Trainings, Career Counselling, Coaching & Career plan mentoring
  • Wellbeing Programs – we support your Zen


Orange Services is about bringing together people and technology.

Come & work for a #TopEmployer company. You could be part of an organization where great colleagues and team spirit support your professional development.


At Orange, you can.


IMPORTANT

In order to be able to follow your application status and receive relevant notifications, make sure to complete your application in our ATS (applicant tracking system), by following the redirection link. Once this step is completed, you will receive a confirmation email from Orange that your application has been successfully registered.


We encourage all candidate profiles, regardless of gender, age, race, citizenship, ethnicity, color, language, religion, social origin, genetic traits, sexual orientation, permanent or temporary disability, nationality, political choice, social category or social origins, situation or family responsibility, belonging to a disadvantaged category, membership or trade union activity.
